reviewer_focus_analysis.complementarity_narrative: Of 375 reviewer concerns, only 31 (8.3%) address code-level issues (MLGG's domain). 208 (55.5%) focus on design-level issues (external validation, clinical utility, study design) that require domain expertise. This demonstrates complementarity: reviewers and MLGG cover different verification layers.

key_findings: 106 NC papers yielded 375 structured methodology concerns
Only 31 concerns (8.3%) address code-level issues — MLGG's primary domain
208 concerns (55.5%) focus on research design — beyond code analysis
Complementarity confirmed: reviewers and MLGG verify different layers
